__Heart notes:__ Peach skin, jasmine

__Base notes:__ Sandalwood, musks, sylvamber

listings.rawTitle: Billie Eilish Your Turn II Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description:
A bold woody-fruity fragrance that blends sweet, fresh, and warm notes for a modern, long-lasting scent.

A deeper, more expressive verison of the original, Billie Eilish Your Turn II Eau De Parfum is designed to contrast light and dark in one wearable fragrance. It opens with juicy mirabelle plum, spicy pimento berry, and crisp cassis leaves. The scent then softens into fig nectar, black tea, and vanilla orchid, before settling into a warm base of vetiver, cedarwood, and resin for a smooth, lasting finish. It evolves beautifully on the skin, moving from bright and fruity to warm and grounding throughout the day.

- Vegan
- Cruelty-free
- Paraben-free

listings.rawTitle: Sabrina Carpenter Cherry Baby Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description:
An amber fruity-gourmand.

Awaken your sophisticated and seductive side with the Sabrina Carpenter Cherry Baby. Playful and provocative, this alluring scent combines the deliciousness of glazed apple and plum nectar with the decadent sweetness of brown sugar and cherry cosmo accord. The heart notes reveal a blend of red poppy, peony blossom, and vanilla orchid which is amplified by hints of dark chocolate. Colour and oh-so enticing, this scent dries down to the richness of cashmere wood, musk, patchouli elixir, and amber resin to add depth to this flirty fragrance.

Scent highlights

Fragrance family: amber fruity-gourmand
Top notes: glazed apple, plum nectar, brown sugar, cherry cosmo accord
Heart notes: red poppy, peony blossom, vanilla orchid, dark chocolate
Base notes: cashmere wood, musk, patchouli elixir, amber resin

listings.rawTitle: Sabrina Carpenter Lemon Pie Eau De Parfum 10ml
listings.description: One spritz and you'll want seconds. Lemon Pie is the fifth flavour in Sabrina Carpenter's Sweet Tooth collection, a bright, juicy gourmand that smells like a fresh baked dessert on a sun soaked afternoon. Created by perfumer Gil Clavien, it opens with a citrus triple threat of candied lemon, Italian bergamot, and sparkling neroli, before a splash of limoncello, jasmine, orange blossom, and violet smooths the zest into airy sweetness. The base is pure indulgence: vanilla bean, liquid sugar, and buttery graham cracker crust, layered like whipped cream over a slice of pie. All served in the collectible chocolate bar bottle in a sunny pastel shade. Vegan and cruelty free.

listings.rawTitle: Sabrina Carpenter Me Espresso Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description:
A gourmand eau de parfum with deep coffee and floral notes.

Spritz on something irresistible with the Sabrina Carpenter Me Espresso Eau de Parfum. This fragrance is inspired by Sabrina Carpenter's hit song. Created by perfumer Gil Clavien, it starts out with Cappuccino Smell-the-Taste™, Cocoa Powder and the bold, addictive aroma of Espresso Bean. This deep, roasted essence is beautifully complemented in the heart by the sensual, floral notes of Vanilla Orchid and Night Blooming Jasmine that add a touch of mystery and sophistication alongside notes of Biscotti. The dry-down of Caramel Drizzle, Sugared Amber and Whipped Cream leaves a lasting impression.

listings.rawTitle: Sabrina Carpenter Sweet Tooth Eau De Parfum 10ml
listings.description:
A delicious, gourmand perfume. 

For a scent that gives nothing but sweet treat, you need the Sabrina Carpenter Sweet Tooth EDP. Sweet but sophisticated, this delightful fragrance opens with the sweetness of marshmallows, chocolate, candied ginger, and bergamot, followed by the creamy accords of Madagascan vanilla, coconut milk, and jasmine petals. As this decadent scent dries down, a sweet symphony of whipped cream, sugar, musk, and cashmere wood rises to add texture and depth for a fragrance that smells like heaven on Earth. 

- Vegan 
- Cruelty-free 

*Scent highlights*

- __Fragrance family:__ gourmand
- __Top notes:__ marshmallow, chocolate, candied ginger, bergamot
- __Heart notes:__ Madagascan vanilla, coconut milk, jasmine
- __Base notes:__ whipped cream, sugar, musk, cashmere wood
